Item Class: Jewels
Rarity: Magic
Large Cluster Jewel of the Prism
--------
Requirements:
Level: 54
--------
Item Level: 68
--------
{ Enchant Modifier }
Adds 8 Passive Skills
(All Added Passive Skills are Small unless otherwise specified)
(Added Passive Skills are never considered to be in Radius by other Jewels)
{ Enchant Modifier }
2 Added Passive Skills are Jewel Sockets
{ Enchant Modifier }
Added Small Passive Skills grant: Wand Attacks deal 12% increased Damage with Hits and Ailments
--------
{ Suffix Modifier "of the Prism" (Tier: 1) — Elemental, Resistance }
Added Small Passive Skills also grant: +3(2-3)% to all Elemental Resistances
--------
Place into an allocated Large Jewel Socket on the Passive Skill Tree. Added passives do not interact with jewel radiuses. Right click to remove from the Socket.
